feedback: I want to retain the same visual fidelity, but I want you to change the game visuals as drastically as possible in the context of being a fisherman, being on top, and grappling colored fish with my fishing rod. I also want subtle nice animations, but want to maintain to same core feeling of the game

selection.reason: Thematic reskin to a fishing game with new animations and visual logic requires coordinated changes across state initialization, game loop, rendering, and state mapping.
